config.title: Seats in Use
config.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot seats assigned out of those purchased. Amber when 40% or more of the seats are unassigned

config.title: Active Users
config.description: Copilot-enabled users who used Copilot in any app in the last 28 days

dataSourceConfig.sql: SELECT 'Last 28 days' AS "label", "activeUsers", "enabledUsers" FROM "adoption" WHERE "app" = 'Any app'

config.title: Prompts
config.description: Prompts submitted to Copilot across all apps in the last 28 days, and the average per active user

dataSourceConfig.sql: SELECT "totalPrompts" AS "prompts", ROUND("averagePrompts") AS "perUser" FROM "adoption" WHERE "app" = 'Any app'

config.title: Copilot Studio Credits
config.description: Whether the tenant is within its prepaid Copilot Credit capacity this month, and how many pay-as-you-go credits it has used

dataSourceConfig.sql: SELECT CASE "capacity.status" WHEN 'WithinCapacity' THEN 'Within capacity' WHEN 'CoveredOverage' THEN 'Overage covered' WHEN 'Overage' THEN 'In overage' ELSE COALESCE("capacity.status", 'Unknown') END AS "label", "capacityState" AS "state", CONCAT_WS(' · ', CASE WHEN "capacity.entitled.value" > 0 THEN FORMAT('{:,.0f} of {:,.0f} prepaid', "capacity.consumed.value", "capacity.entitled.value") END, FORMAT('{:,.0f} pay-as-you-go', COALESCE("payGo.consumed.value", 0))) AS "detail" FROM "credits"

config.title: Adoption by App
config.description: Percentage of Copilot-enabled users who used Copilot in each app in the last 28 days

dataSourceConfig.sql: SELECT "app", "activeRate" AS "rate" FROM "adoption" WHERE "app" NOT IN ('Any app', 'Copilot Chat (all)') ORDER BY "activeRate" DESC, "app"

config.title: Daily Activity
config.description: Users active in any Copilot app each day, and prompts submitted, over the last 28 days

dataSourceConfig.sql: SELECT "reportDate" AS "date", "activeUsers", "promptsSubmitted" AS "prompts" FROM "trend" WHERE "app" = 'Any app' ORDER BY "reportDate"

config.title: Seats by Status
config.description: Copilot-licensed users by seat status: Active (used in the last 7 days), Low use (8–28 days), Idle (over 28 days), Never used, or Possible leaver (account disabled)

dataSourceConfig.sql: SELECT "seatStatus" AS "status", COUNT(*) AS "users" FROM "activity" GROUP BY 1

config.title: Seats to Review
config.description: Licensed users who haven't used Copilot for more than 7 days, have never used it, or whose account is disabled, with their department. Candidates for training or for reclaiming the licence

dataSourceConfig.sql: SELECT "displayName", CASE WHEN CAST("department" AS VARCHAR) LIKE 'Object not found%' THEN NULL ELSE "department" END AS "department", "seatStatus", "lastActivityDate", "daysSinceLastActivity" FROM "activity" WHERE "seatStatus" <> 'Active' ORDER BY "daysSinceLastActivity" DESC NULLS FIRST

config.title: Adoption by Department
config.description: Copilot seats per department, the share used in the last 28 days, and prompts per seat over 28 days. Department comes from Microsoft Entra ID through the imported Copilot Users

dataSourceConfig.sql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CASE WHEN CAST("department" AS VARCHAR) LIKE 'Object not found%' THEN NULL ELSE "department" END), ''), '(No department)') AS "department", COUNT(*) AS "seats", CAST(ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "daysSinceLastActivity" <= 28 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS "activePct", CAST(ROUND(SUM("promptsSubmitted") * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS DOUBLE) AS "promptsPerSeat" FROM "activity" WHERE CAST("department" AS VARCHAR) NOT LIKE 'Object not found%' OR "department" IS NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

config.title: Top Users by Prompts
config.description: The ten users who submitted the most Copilot prompts in the last 28 days

dataSourceConfig.sql: SELECT "user", "prompts" FROM (SELECT "displayName" AS "user", "promptsSubmitted" AS "prompts" FROM "activity" WHERE "promptsSubmitted" > 0 ORDER BY "promptsSubmitted" DESC LIMIT 10) ORDER BY "prompts" ASC

config.title: Credit Allocations by Environment
config.description: Capacity allocated to each Power Platform environment, by currency. Environments that can't hold allocations aren't listed

config.title: Cost Budgets
config.description: Cost Management budgets at the Cost Management scope, with spend so far this period and the forecast at period end. Amber at 80% used or when the forecast exceeds the budget, red when it's exceeded

config.title: Copilot and AI Spend
config.description: Daily Azure cost of Copilot Studio, Copilot pay-as-you-go and Azure AI services from Cost Management, by service, with each service's total for the timeframe

dataSourceConfig.sql: SELECT "usageDate" AS "day", "group" || ' (' || "currency" || ')' AS "service", SUM("cost") AS "cost" FROM "spend" GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

config.title: Copilot Emissions
config.description: Monthly carbon emissions from Microsoft 365 Copilot use, by emissions scope (scope 2 location-based), as reported by Microsoft Graph. Microsoft's Emissions Impact Dashboard reports these figures in metric tons of CO2e

dataSourceConfig.sql: SELECT "monthStart" AS "month", 'Scope 1' AS "scope", CAST(SUM("scope1Emissions") AS DOUBLE) AS "emissions" FROM "emissions" GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT "monthStart", 'Scope 2', CAST(SUM("scope2LocationBasedEmissions") AS DOUBLE) FROM "emissions" GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT "monthStart", 'Scope 3', CAST(SUM("scope3Emissions") AS DOUBLE) FROM "emissions" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1, 2

config.title: AI App Sign-ins
config.description: Sign-ins over the last 30 days to AI apps that use Microsoft Entra sign-in, such as Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise or Claude connectors to Microsoft 365. Apps are recognised by name, and personal AI accounts aren't seen

config.title: AI App Permissions
config.description: What AI apps people sign in to have been allowed to do: delegated permissions granted for all users or by individual users, and application permissions, with the API each is granted on. Red marks grants that go beyond basic sign-in

dataSourceConfig.sql: SELECT "appDisplayName", "publisher", "resource", "grantedTo", COALESCE("userDisplayName", '') AS "user", "permissions", CASE WHEN "beyondSignIn" THEN 'Beyond sign-in' ELSE 'Sign-in only' END AS "reach" FROM "grants" ORDER BY "beyondSignIn" DESC, "appDisplayName", "grantedTo"

config.title: Possible Leavers
config.description: Copilot seats whose user hasn't signed in to Microsoft Entra for 30 days or whose account is disabled, from live sign-in data. Needs AuditLog.Read.All and Microsoft Entra ID P1 or P2

dataSourceConfig.sql: SELECT s."displayName", s."userPrincipalName", CASE WHEN s."accountEnabled" = false THEN 'Account disabled' ELSE 'No recent sign-in' END AS "reason", s."lastSignInDateTime", DATE_DIFF('day', CAST(s."lastSignInDateTime" AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(NOW() AS TIMESTAMP)) AS "daysSinceSignIn", a."lastActivityDate" FROM "signins" s LEFT JOIN "activity" a ON LOWER(a."userPrincipalName") = LOWER(s."userPrincipalName") WHERE s."accountEnabled" = false OR s."lastSignInDateTime" IS NULL OR CAST(s."lastSignInDateTime" AS TIMESTAMP) < NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY ORDER BY "daysSinceSignIn" DESC NULLS FIRST
